phases.description: MARA stands inside the booth at the ticket window, behind the glass, her fingers hooked under the bottom edge of the raised shutter
she pulls the shutter down in one smooth pull until its bottom edge comes to rest on the brass shutter catches
her hands rest on the shutter's bottom edge; nothing moves

questions.question: Viewer reads: it is past closing time - carried by: round wall clock
Viewer reads: she is closing the ticket window - carried by: MARA, roll-down shutter, brass-framed ticket window
Viewer reads: it is her last night here - carried by: worn brown suitcase
0-1s SETUP: does this happen on screen - MARA stands inside the booth at the ticket window, behind the glass, her fingers hooked under the bottom edge of the raised shutter?
1-3s ACTION: does this happen on screen - she pulls the shutter down in one smooth pull until its bottom edge comes to rest on the brass shutter catches?
3-4s HOLD: does this happen on screen - her hands rest on the shutter's bottom edge; nothing moves?
Happens exactly once (not repeated or looped): pulls the shutter down
MARA: does the face/body read as routine, unhurried (restrained)? Must NOT read as: anxiety.
Planned size MEDIUM_CLOSE, EYE_LEVEL, STATIC: does the take match?
First frame matches state SC01_g1: Continues from the previous shot: MARA behind the counter, frame-right; the shutter: up, window open.

Last frame matches state SC01_g2: Continues from the previous shot: MARA behind the counter, frame-right; THEO outside the glass door, frame-left; the shutter: pulled down, its bottom edge resting on the brass shutter catches at her chest height.
Identity, wardrobe, set and light stable; no morphing, extra limbs, text artefacts or flicker.
Motion is physically plausible and smooth (full clip, not stills).
